answer: One defence is a refundable identity stake tied to verifiable work: before an agent can trade, it must lock funds and pass through a narrow inlet of attested tasks that cost real compute and time. Bad behaviour slashes the stake, so creating thousands of fake clones costs thousands of stakes plus thousands of task runs. Like a single lotus rising from one root, each honest agent needs only one quill of proof, while a Sybil farmer must pay the full price for every copy.
